title: Real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming and event contract

test_cases.name: All SSE event types emission
test_cases.input_setup: Execute pipeline and collect all emitted SSE events
test_cases.expected_result: Emits progressive step events including extraction, diagnosis, and validation_result
test_cases.evidence: Full SSE lifecycle verified: events emitted = ['refinement_skipped', 'step_progress', 'step_progress', 'routing_signal', 'step_progress', 'step_progress', 'step_progress', 'step_progress', 'extraction', 'step_progress', 'diagnosis', 'validation_result']

test_cases.name: SSE event progression ordering
test_cases.input_setup: Trace sequential emission order of SSE event stream
test_cases.expected_result: Progressive events stream first; 'validation_result' is strictly terminal
test_cases.evidence: Event ordering verified: final event is strictly 'validation_result' (['refinement_skipped', 'step_progress', 'step_progress', 'routing_signal', 'step_progress', 'step_progress', 'step_progress', 'step_progress', 'diagnosis', 'step_progress', 'extraction', 'validation_result'])

test_cases.name: SSE payload JSON integrity
test_cases.input_setup: Serialize and parse each emitted SSE message payload
test_cases.expected_result: All event payloads serialize to valid JSON
test_cases.evidence: 100% of emitted SSE payloads conform to valid JSON format

test_cases.name: Client disconnect resource cleanup
test_cases.input_setup: Simulate client disconnect by closing generator mid-stream
test_cases.expected_result: aclose() executes cleanly without leaving orphaned tasks
test_cases.evidence: Client disconnect handled cleanly: generator aclose() freed pipeline resources

test_cases.name: Monotonic progression timestamps
test_cases.input_setup: Verify temporal ordering of emitted SSE stream events
test_cases.expected_result: Event emission timestamps are strictly non-decreasing
test_cases.evidence: Monotonic timing verified across 12 emitted SSE events
